# Psalm 73 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-psalm of-Asaph. Surely good to-Israel God, to-the-pure-of heart.

**2** And-I almost were-turned-aside my-feet, as-nothing were-poured-out my-steps.

**3** For I-was-envious of-the-arrogant; the-prosperity-of the-wicked I-would-see.

**4** For there-are-no bonds to-their-death, and-fat their-body.

**5** In-trouble-of mortals they-are not, and-with humanity not they-are-plagued.

**6** Therefore has-encircled-them pride-as-a-necklace; covers-them a-garment-of violence.

**7** Has-come-forth from-fatness their-eye; have-passed-over imaginations-of the-heart.

**8** They-mock and-speak in-wickedness; oppression from-on-high they-speak.

**9** They-have-set in-the-heavens their-mouth, and-their-tongue walks through-the-earth.

**10** Therefore returns his-people here, and-waters-of fullness are-drained by-them.

**11** And-they-say, 'How does-God-know? And-is-there knowledge in-the-Most-High?'

**12** Behold these the-wicked, and-at-ease-of world they-have-increased wealth.

**13** Surely in-vain I-have-purified my-heart, and-I-have-washed in-innocence my-hands.

**14** And-I-have-been plagued all the-day, and-my-chastisement every-morning.

**15** If I-had-said, 'I-will-speak thus,' behold the-generation-of your-children I-would-have-betrayed.

**16** And-I-thought to-understand this — trouble it-was in-my-eyes,

**17** Until I-came to-sanctuary-of God; I-discerned their-end.

**18** Surely in-slippery-places you-set them; you-cast-them-down to-ruin.

**19** How they-have-become a-desolation in-a-moment! They-are-finished, consumed from-terrors.

**20** Like-a-dream upon-awakening, O-Lord, in-awakening their-image you-will-despise.

**21** When was-embittered my-heart, and-in-my-kidneys I-was-pierced,

**22** And-I was-brutish and-not I-knew; like-beasts I-was with-you.

**23** And-I continually with-you; you-have-grasped my-hand right.

**24** With-your-counsel you-will-guide-me, and-afterward to-glory you-will-take-me.

**25** Who to-me in-the-heavens? And-with-you not I-desire on-the-earth.

**26** Has-failed my-flesh and-my-heart; rock-of my-heart and-my-portion God to-forever.

**27** For behold those-far from-you will-perish; you-have-destroyed all who-go-whoring from-you.

**28** And-I the-nearness-of God to-me is-good; I-have-made in-Lord YHWH my-refuge, to-recount all your-works.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **73:4**: Hebrew chartzubbot — 'bonds/pangs' — may indicate no death-struggles; 'fat their body' (bari'ul) — robust health.

- **73:22**: 'Like-beasts' (behemot) — plural of intensity; the psalmist sees his former envy as sub-human ignorance.

- **73:24**: 'Afterward to-glory you-will-take-me' — debated: does 'glory' imply afterlife? The Hebrew is ambiguous but suggestive.

— EMET
